title: Compath Choir Rehearsal
tagline: A private rehearsal library for choirs: songs, voice tracks, optional YouTube embeds, PDF scores, and easy listening on phone or desktop.
overview: Choir Rehearsal helps choir members learn new pieces by voice part. A Voice Leader uploads PDF scores and audio — or links an official YouTube video per voice track. Singers visit /rehearsal/, pick a song, and listen. Lite is free from WordPress.org and GitHub; Pro is a separate add-on from shop.compath.ee (keep Lite installed — do not replace it).
features: Song library — paginated list on your choir website with shortcode embedding
PDF scores — attach sheet music and flip pages in the built-in viewer
Voice tracks — bass, tenor, alto, soprano and more
Sticky player — listen while reading the score
YouTube tracks — optional official embed per voice part (video stays visible; no download)
Private access — optional login-only rehearsal pages
Singer & Voice Leader roles — WordPress roles created on install (English names)
Lite (free) — WordPress.org or GitHub, up to 4 tracks per song, audio upload
Pro add-on — unlimited tracks, mic recording, search, editor Play, embedded PDF in the editor

items: One-time setup on your WordPress site
/rehearsal/ page created
Singer and Voice Leader roles configured
Voice Leader training (1 session)
First year of Pro included

orderSteps: Open https://shop.compath.ee/products/choir-rehearsal-pro/ (or email order@compath.ee for setup services).
After payment, download choir-rehearsal-pro.zip from your SureCart customer dashboard.
Keep Choir Rehearsal (Lite) installed. Upload and activate the Pro add-on beside it — do not replace Lite.
installSteps: Install Lite from WordPress.org (search “Compath Choir Rehearsal”) or upload the zip from GitHub Releases.
In WordPress: Plugins → Add New → activate Compath Choir Rehearsal (Lite).
Pro customers: upload choir-rehearsal-pro.zip next and activate it. Settings should show Edition: Pro.
The plugin creates a /rehearsal/ page with the [choir_rehearsal] shortcode and WordPress roles Singer and Voice Leader (English names).
Add a song: Choir Rehearsal → Add Song — title, PDF, voice tracks (Audio or YouTube per track; needs Voice Leader or Administrator).
Assign Users → Singer for listening, Voice Leader for managing songs. Settings remain Administrator-only.
